overview_description.description: Pepper provides an AI-powered sales platform designed for food distributors and suppliers to manage customer engagement and order workflows. The platform centralizes product catalogs, pricing, promotions, and inventory data, allowing sales representatives and customers to place and manage orders digitally. Pepper integrates with existing ERP and accounting systems to synchronize order processing, invoicing, and reporting functions. Its tools support mobile sales, real-time communication, and data tracking to streamline interactions between distributors and their buyers. The system also includes analytics features that help teams monitor purchasing patterns, manage accounts, and coordinate sales activities across channels.

about_short_description.short_description: Pepper provides an AI-powered eCommerce platform for food distributors and suppliers to manage customer engagement and order workflows.

product.name: Pepper Platform
product.description: A cloud-based eCommerce platform for food and beverage distributors to manage digital ordering, customer engagement, sales workflows, marketing, and payments.

product.name: Storefront
product.description: A branded web and mobile ordering experience that lets foodservice operators browse catalogs, view pricing and availability, place orders, reorder products, and make payments.

product.name: Order Agent
product.description: An AI order-entry system that interprets inbound orders from voice, text, email, PDFs, photos, and handwriting, matches items to a distributor’s catalog, and sends orders to the ERP.

product.name: Sales Hub
product.description: A sales-enablement workspace for distributor sales representatives that supports account management, prospecting, quoting, pricing, customer insights, and mobile order workflows.

product.name: Finance Hub
product.description: A distributor accounts-receivable and payments solution that supports card, ACH, check, terminal, autopay, pay-by-link, payment plans, reconciliation, and customer self-service.

product.name: Marketing Hub
product.description: A digital marketing and promotions solution for distributors and suppliers that delivers targeted product ads, promotions, and customer communications within ordering workflows.
